description: Defines the implementation class for PDU session management, including dependencies, session setup/modification/removal, TEID allocation, and session control functions within the ocudu::ocuup namespace.

classes.name: pdu_session_manager_dependencies
classes.description: Struct holding dependencies required by the PDU session manager implementation.

classes.name: pdu_session_manager_impl
classes.description: Final class implementing the PDU session management logic, including setup, modification, removal, and TEID allocation.

methods.name: setup_pdu_session
methods.description: Sets up a new PDU session based on the provided session request.

methods.name: modify_pdu_session
methods.description: Modifies an existing PDU session with new parameters.

methods.name: remove_pdu_session
methods.description: Removes a PDU session identified by its session ID.

methods.name: get_nof_pdu_sessions
methods.description: Returns the number of active PDU sessions.

methods.name: get_pdu_session_state
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of PDU sessions.

methods.name: update_security_config
methods.description: Updates the security configuration for the session manager.

methods.name: notify_pdcp_pdu_processing_stopped
methods.description: Notifies that PDCP PDU processing has stopped.

methods.name: await_crypto_rx_all_pdu_sessions
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for all crypto receive operations on PDU sessions.

methods.name: await_crypto_rx_all_drbs
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for all crypto receive operations on DRBs for a given PDU session.

methods.name: await_crypto_tx_all_pdu_sessions
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for all crypto transmit operations on PDU sessions.

methods.name: await_crypto_tx_all_drbs
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for all crypto transmit operations on DRBs for a given PDU session.

methods.name: allocate_local_teid
methods.description: Allocates a new local NG-U TEID based on UE ID and PDU session ID.
